sdkVersion.description: The SwiftBindings.Sdk NuGet package version to use.

appleFramework.description: Name of an Apple system framework to bind (e.g., WeatherKit, CryptoKit). Scaffolds a multi-TFM project with SwiftAppleFrameworkTarget.

platform.description: The target Apple platform (ignored when --apple-framework is set).

framework.description: Managed target framework; .NET 11 requires its matching Apple workload and Xcode.

manualInstructions.text:
Next steps:
  1. Copy your .xcframework into the project directory
     (or add <SwiftFramework Include="path/to/Library.xcframework" /> to the .csproj)
  2. Run 'dotnet build' to generate and compile the C# bindings
  3. Reference this project from your .NET MAUI or iOS app

For more information, see: https://github.com/justinwojo/swift-dotnet-bindings/wiki/Getting-Started
